system.text:
Great Wolves can smell a Ghost of the Wood when he is near. His scent is distinct, a mix of Ancient Ways and twisted speech that covers his coat like the blood of the hunted. This stink causes fear, trepidation and even hatred in Great Wolves. They do not look kindly upon one who so tampers with the will of the Grandfather. This trait grants a 1D infamous reputation as a Ghost of the Deeping Wood among the packs. Combine this with other reputations as appropriate.

Type: Dt. Unpriced: costs 1 pt as a lifepath trait.

Restrictions: Great Wolf lifepath trait

Source: Burning Wheel Codex, p. 530
